query: Hey there, I just wanted to say I absolutely love the new cat bed I ordered last week—my tabby Mochi has been curled up in it nonstop ever since it arrived, she even stopped napping on my laptop keyboard when I work from home. Oh, and I also wanted to mention I tried the lavender laundry detergent sample you included in my last order, it smells so good I just ordered a full bottle of it this morning actually. The delivery driver who dropped off my last package was so nice too, he even waited a minute when I had to run to grab my ID from the kitchen so I didn't have to reschedule the dropoff. Anyway, I need to update the shipping address on my most recent order, could you help me modify it for user ID fatima_taylor_3452? The new address is 157 Oak Street, Suite 258, Phoenix, AZ 85033, USA.
